text_block_list.text:
To build her popularity as an Umamusume, 
Haru Urara was assigned to promote the 
shopping district. She carries out her PR 
work brightly and cheerfully.

The locals from the shopping district talk 
about how, thanks to the cheerful Haru 
Urara, lively energy has returned to their 
once quiet streets.

They explained that even if she lost, they 
just wanted to see Haru Urara having fun 
while running.

Hearing those words, the Trainer began to 
question whether that was truly the right 
thing to do.
